name: PT Autopedia Sukses Lestari Tbk
summary: PT Autopedia Sukses Lestari Tbk engages in the auction of two and four-wheeled vehicles under the BidWin brand name in Indonesia and internationally. The company is also involved in the retail sale of new and used cars, including vehicles comprising ambulances, caravans, minibuses, firetrucks, trucks, trailers, semi-trailers, and various other motorized vehicles; and retail sales of used motorcycles, such as bicycles or mopeds. In addition, it engages in the publishing of software; operation of commercial purpose web portals and/or digital platforms; and provision of business consulting and brokerage services, as well as pawning services.
